description: Aggregate expenses and/or income by category, parent category, payee, account or time (day/week/month/year) with totals, counts and shares. measure=both gives income, expense and net per group (cash flow). Transfers and debts are excluded; amounts are converted with current rates. By default only in-balance accounts count, like ZenMoney reports.

accounts.description: Account names, ids or card last digits; matches money leaving or arriving

categories.description: Category names, "Parent / Child" paths or ids; subcategories are included

currency.description: Only transactions in this currency (ISO code)

include_off_balance.description: Also count accounts excluded from the balance

max_amount.description: Maximum amount in the account's currency

min_amount.description: Minimum amount in the account's currency

payee.description: Substring of the payee / merchant name

period.description: Date range relative to today (weeks start on Monday). date_from/date_to override either end.

report_currency.description: ISO code to report in; defaults to the main currency

search.description: Free text matched against payee, merchant, comment and category names

top.description: Max groups for non-time groupings; the rest is rolled up

types.description: Transaction types to include: expense | income | transfer (between own accounts) | debt_out (money given to a person: lending, or repaying them) | debt_in (money received from a person: borrowing, or them repaying you)

name: summarize_transactions
title: Spending / income report
